subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1128
title: Provides that a police officer or firefighter member of the Public Employees Retirement System is considered disabled if the member is unable to perform the work the member performed at the time the member became disabled.
headline: SB 1128 did not pass

claims.text: SB 1128 was introduced in the Senate on February 27, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
